title: Krea2 swap workflows: face / head / character - co-develop in the node graph
description:
Collaborative workflow-authoring track. The user authors in the ComfyUI node graph; the agent supplies the krea2edit v1.2.2 node semantics, the graph topology, and the measured regimes so nothing gets re-derived at the bench. Goal is a working Krea2 swap family - face swap, head swap, character swap/restage - proven in the graph BEFORE any App is built. App outcomes discovered along the way get spun out as their own cards. Target release: v1.3 = the Apps release. brief.md is the working reference - READ IT before assisting, it holds every node semantic, trap, and node id.

MERGED 2026-08-01: this card absorbs MPI-366 (Investigate the shared Krea2 ID-Edit character-dataset workflow as an App candidate).
- MPI-366 - read and evaluate a community Krea2 identity-edit workflow that builds a tagged character dataset from one reference image.
WHY ONE CARD: MPI-366 is an input to this track, not a separate one: it is a Krea2 identity-edit graph that gets read at the same bench, in the same session, and its useful parts feed the swap family this card is authoring. Both also need the user at the node graph and one of them needs the VPN, so they are the same sitting.
The absorbed card(s) are closed as done/rejected - not built, kept as the record - and their full original text stays on disk at tasks/<id>/.
